reviews.t: This products contains the toxic chemicals methylene chloride and methanol.
reviews.x: There has been much discussion about this product on Amazon and professional nail tech blogs.  One of the most serious issues is the absence of a safety data sheet (SDS) from the manufacturer.  By law, manufacturers selling chemical products in the United States must provide accurately documented SDS upon request.  The manufacturer of this product has not provided such a SDS.  We ordered a product through Amazon which arrived via China Post/USPS identified as 'Makeup Tools' for customs purposes.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the product simply does not work for removing gel or dip polish, even after leaving it on for extended periods.
Several reviewers describe the product as painful or dangerous, citing burning, tingling, or a tightening sensation on nails and skin.
Positive reviewers say it works as promised and is a great alternative to foil, clips, or acetone soaking.
Some reviewers raise safety concerns about toxic chemicals and the absence of a safety data sheet.
A few reviewers mention shipping or packaging problems, including an empty package shipped from China.
